let state;try{state={...initial,...JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('littleAcreSave')||'{}')};state.inventory={...initial.inventory,...state.inventory};state.harvest={...initial.harvest,...state.harvest};if(!Array.isArray(state.plots)||state.plots.length!==9)state.plots=initial.plots.map(p=>({...p}));}catch{state=structuredClone(initial)}
let hover=null,toastTimer;const cellW=76,cellH=38,origin={x:510,y:310},seasonIndex=()=>Math.floor((state.day-1)/7)%4,dayInSeason=()=>((state.day-1)%7)+1;
function save(){try{localStorage.setItem('littleAcreSave',JSON.stringify(state))}catch{}}
function notify(msg){const el=document.querySelector('#toast');el.innerHTML=msg;el.classList.add('show');clearTimeout(toastTimer);toastTimer=setTimeout(()=>el.classList.remove('show'),2100)}
function draw(){const s=SEASONS[seasonIndex()];ctx.clearRect(0,0,1000,565);
 // sky and distant rolling hills
 let sky=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,420);sky.addColorStop(0,s.sky);sky.addColorStop(1,'#d7e3cf');ctx.fillStyle=sky;ctx.fillRect(0,0,1000,565);

 ctx.fillStyle=s.far;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,202);ctx.bezierCurveTo(150,132,260,184,396,146);ctx.bezierCurveTo(570,94,695,187,1000,125);ctx.lineTo(1000,360);ctx.lineTo(0,360);ctx.fill();
 ctx.fillStyle=s.ground;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,286);ctx.bezierCurveTo(170,218,335,295,493,235);ctx.bezierCurveTo(670,177,796,290,1000,218);ctx.lineTo(1000,565);ctx.lineTo(0,565);ctx.fill();
 // meadow glow and subtle ground flecks
 const glow=ctx.createRadialGradient(530,338,10,530,338,440);glow.addColorStop(0,'#e1e4a927');glow.addColorStop(1,'#fff0');ctx.fillStyle=glow;ctx.fillRect(0,180,1000,385);
 for(let i=0;i<95;i++){let x=(i*173+31)%1000,y=285+(i*91%265);ctx.fillStyle=i%3?'#edf0c123':'#fff8df28';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x,y,2+(i%3),1.2,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill()}
 drawCloud(165,87,.8);drawCloud(405,66,.58);

 for(let sum=0;sum<=4;sum++)for(let r=0;r<3;r++){const c=sum-r;if(c<0||c>2)continue;drawPlot(c,r,s)}

 drawSign(748,377);drawPlayer();

}
function coord(c,r){return{x:origin.x+(c-r)*cellW,y:origin.y+(c+r)*cellH}}
function diamond(x,y,fill,stroke='#fff8e4',line=2){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,y-cellH);ctx.lineTo(x+cellW,y);ctx.lineTo(x,y+cellH);ctx.lineTo(x-cellW,y);ctx.closePath();ctx.fillStyle=fill;ctx.fill();ctx.lineWidth=line;ctx.strokeStyle=stroke;ctx.stroke()}

 diamond(p.x,p.y,'#6f8058','#e5dcad',2);
 const soil=plot.tilled?'#9a7354':'#8fa76c';diamond(p.x,p.y-2,soil,plot.tilled?'#bd9367':'#aec18a',1.5);
 if(plot.tilled){ctx.save();ctx.strokeStyle='#71523d';ctx.globalAlpha=.48;ctx.lineWidth=2;for(let j=-2;j<=2;j++){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(p.x-47,p.y+j*7-1);ctx.lineTo(p.x+47,p.y+j*7+1);ctx.stroke()}ctx.restore()}

 else if(plot.watered){ctx.fillStyle='#7faeba';ctx.globalAlpha=.75;ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(p.x+38,p.y-6,9,4,-.3,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.globalAlpha=1}
 // seedling-sized sparkle when selected / tilled empty
 if(hover&&hover.c===c&&hover.r===r&&!plot.crop){ctx.fillStyle='#f9f2cf';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x,p.y-4,2.4,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill()}
}

 // leafy silhouette grows in stages
 ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,y);let scale=.62+Math.min(age,3)*.17;ctx.scale(scale,scale);
 ctx.strokeStyle='#426844';ctx.lineWidth=4;ctx.lineCap='round';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,13);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-3,-8,0,-22);ctx.stroke();
 for(const side of [-1,1]){ctx.fillStyle=watered?'#6e9a5e':'#799164';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(side*10,-7,11,5,side*.4,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(side*14,2,9,4,-side*.35,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill()}
 if(age>=2){ctx.fillStyle='#82a967';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(0,-19,8,11,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill()}
 if(ready){ctx.fillStyle=data.color;for(let i=0;i<3;i++){let a=i*2.1;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(Math.cos(a)*11,-17+Math.sin(a)*5,6.3,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill()}ctx.fillStyle='#f8e9a2';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,-17,4,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill()}
 else if(crop.type==='tomato'&&age>=2){ctx.fillStyle='#df705c';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(4,-11,5,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill()}
 ctx.restore();
 if(ready){ctx.fillStyle='#fff5cf';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x+19,y-27,3,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.fillStyle='#fff5cf88';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x+19,y-27,6,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill()}
 if(watered){ctx.fillStyle='#b8e4e6';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(p.x-28,p.y-12,3,5,-.4,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill()}
}

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable desktop 2D farm game: “2D Pocket Stardew Valley with a 3×3 farm and seasons.”

## Requirements
- Build now without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them upon completion.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport ≤1280px wide) and inspect only the latest.

- Implemented a standalone browser game in `index.html`, with canvas-drawn farm scenery and responsive HTML/CSS UI.
- Game assumes a 7-day season cycle, four seasons, seasonal crops, rain, and localStorage persistence.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the responsive game UI, 3×3 farm canvas, player, scenery, crop plots, tool selection, keyboard/mouse interaction, seed shop, inventory, stamina, quest, selling, sleeping, seasonal progression, and save/load logic in `index.html`.
- Corrected a canvas-path overlap in the farm scene and replaced an unsupported emoji in the crop data.

- No browser screenshot or interaction test has been completed.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable desktop 2D farm game, “2D Pocket Stardew Valley with a 3×3 farm and seasons.”

## Requirements
- Build without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them upon completion.
- For visual checks, save a small JPEG (viewport ≤1280px wide) and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented a standalone browser game in `index.html` with canvas-drawn scenery and responsive HTML/CSS UI.
- Assumed 7-day seasons, four seasons, seasonal crops, rain, and localStorage persistence.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the game UI and core mechanics in `index.html`: 3×3 plots, player, tools, seed shop, inventory, stamina, quest, selling, sleeping, seasonal progression, and save/load.
- Adjusted the farm scene path and replaced the unsupported 🫛 crop emoji with 🥬.

### Active
- Validate JavaScript and test game rendering and interactions in a browser.
- Capture and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- Inline-script syntax validation still fails with `SyntaxError: Invalid or unexpected token` on the `CROPS` declaration; the emoji replacement did not resolve it.
- No browser gameplay test or screenshot inspection has been completed.

## Next Move
1. Diagnose and fix the syntax error in the `CROPS` declaration, then rerun `node --check`.
2. Launch the page and test rendering and core farm interactions.
3. Save and inspect a latest JPEG screenshot.
4. Summarize the finished game and assumptions briefly.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Entire game implementation.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
